Container.Name: soulseek-picker
Container.Overview: Hand-pick the exact edition of an album from Soulseek. beets tags it to that edition in place; Lidarr is told which edition it is and Plex rescans the folder. Replace UNRAID_IP in the URLs below with this server's LAN IP: on the bridge network container names don't resolve.
Container.Requires: slskd 0.26 or newer (reached through Gluetun) and Lidarr. Lidarr: Write Audio Tags = Never; a Webhook connection to http://UNRAID_IP:8765/hooks/lidarr on Release Import and Upgrade.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The picker's web page and Lidarr's webhook target.

Config.Name: Media data
Config.Description: One share holding slskd's downloads and the music library, mapped exactly as in slskd and Lidarr (/mnt/user/mediadata -> /mediadata).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings, beets config and library, spectrograms, probe output.

Config.Name: slskd URL
Config.Description: slskd shares Gluetun's network; port 5030 is published on Gluetun.

Config.Name: slskd API key
Config.Description: An slskd API key (web.authentication.api_keys). Leave empty to enter it on the Settings page instead.

Config.Name: slskd download dir
Config.Description: slskd's download directory, as seen inside this container. Must equal slskd's own setting.

Config.Name: Music library
Config.Description: The library root, same path as in Lidarr.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Lidarr, by the server's LAN IP.

Config.Name: Lidarr API key
Config.Description: Lidarr: Settings, General, API Key. Leave empty to enter it on the Settings page instead.

Config.Name: Lidarr root folder
Config.Description: Root folder used when the picker adds an artist to Lidarr.

Config.Name: Webhook username
Config.Description: Username in Lidarr's Webhook connection to /hooks/lidarr.

Config.Name: Webhook password
Config.Description: Password in Lidarr's Webhook connection. The webhook is refused until this is set.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Plex Media Server, by the server's LAN IP.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: X-Plex-Token. Leave empty to enter it on the Settings page instead.

Config.Name: Plex music section ID
Config.Description: The music library's section ID (the probe lists them).

Config.Name: Plex library path
Config.Description: Only if Plex sees the library under a different path. Empty: Plex uses /mediadata/media/music too.

Config.Name: MusicBrainz contact
Config.Description: An email address or URL sent in the MusicBrainz User-Agent, as MusicBrainz asks.
